title: Spectator don't last long
lyrics:
spectating
I am gaining
the power,
this pickleball hour

Energy's rising.
Sitting, Dispising 
can't resit,
The pickle bliss.

itchy feet
hold onto your seat
the force is strong with this one
PICKLEBALLIN'

mmmmmmmm

player on fire, 
mmm no longer lyer
.......mmmmmm,

...to yourself.

mmmmmmmm

Session half done,
tonights the one.
Spectator in position,
ready to transition.

mmmmmmmmmm

like a moth to a flame
can't resist the game!

spectator sprung,
stood up, and sung.....
"I'llllllll plllllllaaaaaaaay, the next oooone"

mmmmmmmmm

pickleball

mmmmmmmmm

pickleball, that's all!

dooby dooby doop do do do dah.
